lines.zh: 我横着走，钳子抬得高高。
lines.en: I walk sideways with my pincers held high.
I keep steady footing among mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳在水里泛着暗光。
lines.en: My shell glimmers darkly in the water.

lines.zh: 六条腿踩着软泥，不陷下去。
lines.en: Six legs step on soft mud without sinking.
I move slowly along the tide line.

lines.zh: 钳子上的源石碎粒在响。
lines.en: Originium grains click on my pincers.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛水草，继续走。
lines.en: I go around a clump of weeds and walk on.

lines.zh: 我每一步都先试一试地面。
lines.en: I test the ground before each step.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水没到我的腹甲。
lines.en: Swamp water reaches my belly plate.
I climb from the shallows onto the mud bank.
I glance back at the water.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水面上散成几块。
lines.en: My shadow breaks into pieces on the water.
I close my pincers, then open them.
Muddy water drips from my shell.

lines.zh: 我蹲在红树根上晒太阳。
lines.en: I squat on a mangrove root, sunning myself.
My eye stalks turn slowly.
Something is moving under the water.

lines.zh: 源石在我背上长成一小块。
lines.en: Originium has grown in a small patch on my back.

lines.zh: 我把壳上的泥一点点刮掉。
lines.en: I scrape the mud off my shell bit by bit.
The swamp is close and damp.
I listen to the bubbles on the water.
My pincers can snap a branch.
The tide is slowly going out.

lines.zh: 我把一只钳子搭在泥上。
lines.en: I rest one pincer on the mud.

lines.zh: 红树的根缠着我的影子。
lines.en: Mangrove roots tangle with my shadow.

lines.zh: 水滴从我的钳尖滑下去。
lines.en: Drops slide off my pincer tips.

lines.zh: 周围有几只同伴，各忙各的。
lines.en: Several of my kind are nearby, each busy.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被我一搅就浑。
lines.en: One stir of mine muddies the bottom.

lines.zh: 我的甲片一节节收紧了。
lines.en: My plates draw in, segment by segment.
A bird skims over the swamp.
These shallows are my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，只是让你看。
lines.en: I lift my pincers only to show you.
I know the paths in this water.
Your hands are dusted with originium.
Originium grows on my shell. Do not touch it.

lines.zh: 我可以用钳子给你递东西。
lines.en: I can pass you things with my pincers.
Want to tame me? Feed me first.
The swamp is deeper than it looks.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬得能夹断枯枝。
lines.en: My shell is hard; my pincers can snap dry branches.
You are standing in the water. Bad for you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往你这边横着挪。
lines.en: I edge sideways toward you.
You waded the swamp; your boots are still wet.
I do not start trouble.
The weeds have caught your feet.
I look up at you, water dripping from my shell.
I have lived here a long while.
A chip broke off my shell.
My pincer joint has gone numb.
My pincers slackened.
Blood seeps out mixed with water.
I draw my body into my shell.
Something got into my shell seam.
I press flat to the mud and hold still.
My eye stalks pull in.
I raise my pincers higher.
Pain or not, my pincers still work.
That thing in your hand — for me?

lines.zh: 我横着挪过去，钳子先伸。
lines.en: I sidle over, pincers first.
I smell it in the water.
Lower it; I cannot reach.
I will take it with my pincer. Do not shake.
One bite of this, and I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我把它夹在钳间看了看。
lines.en: I hold it between my pincers and look.
There is not much to find in a swamp.
Half a step back and I will come.

lines.zh: 吃完我把壳上的泥抖给你。
lines.en: After eating I will shake the mud at you.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞起来像块石头。
lines.en: My shell hits like stone.
You touched my pincer.
I sidle aside a little.
That shoved me off my line.
We are crowded between the roots.
We have muddied the water between us.
My legs slip in the water.
Do not step on my pincer.
I shove back. Hard.
We both sink into the mud.

lines.zh: 我们四个一起在这片水里。
lines.en: Four of us share this patch of water.

lines.zh: 我用钳子轻轻敲你的壳。
lines.en: I tap your shell lightly with my pincer.
The tide is out; let us dig a burrow.

lines.zh: 钳子一合，河面就安静了。
lines.en: One snap of my claws and the river goes quiet.
Our pincers are much the same color.
The mud can hide both of us.
When the water rises, we go.
Keep the waterbirds away.
I walk sideways beside you.

lines.zh: 这一片沼泽够我们过冬。
lines.en: This swamp will see us through winter.

lines.zh: 红树林的泥里，我的钳子最灵。
lines.en: In mangrove mud, my pincers work best.
It slipped. I try again.
This was half buried in the mud.
I hold it up for you to see.
Clamp too hard and it breaks.
The dark-tide claw tucks under its shell.
These claws in the water grab anything.
Too heavy; my pincers will not close.
It carries originium dust.
I set it down. I will not take it.
That thing moved.

lines.zh: 我把两只钳子都抬起来。
lines.en: I raise both pincers.
I have my place at the bottom.
I shift sideways to block your retreat.

lines.zh: 它比我大，可壳不如我硬。
lines.en: It is bigger, but its shell is softer.
Once I clamp, I do not let go.

lines.zh: 沼泽里我的钳，一夹两块甲。
lines.en: My pincers in the swamp snap two shells at once.
My pincer is open. Don't rush.
The muddy water will hide my movement.
I have settled on you.
In the dark tide, I walk sideways.
You shift an inch; my pincer follows.
You move slowly in the mud.
I wait for you to step into soft mud.

lines.zh: 红树的根挡住你的退路。
lines.en: Mangrove roots block your retreat.
I turn sideways, pincers toward you.
Ripples on the water give me away.
New angle, and the pincer reaches.
Listen — there is a sound in the mud.
Only a few steps between us.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被夹出一道痕。
lines.en: Your armor takes a pinch mark.
I ram sideways into it.
That clamped onto its leg.

lines.zh: 它被我从泥里拖了出来。
lines.en: I dragged it out of the mud.
My shell forces its armor aside.
Muddy water splashes everywhere.
It retreats; I follow sideways.
It wrenched free of my pincers.
This time I catch your elbow.
I release my grip and sink.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥里，我的钳先露头。
lines.en: In the marsh mud, my claws surface first.
The swamp's surface stirs.
Four of us surface together.

lines.zh: 红树根下多了一只钳兽。
lines.en: There is one more pincer beast under the roots.
Weeds still hang from my shell.
I climb out between the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 我先张开一只钳子试水。
lines.en: I open one pincer to test the water.

lines.zh: 源石碎粒在我背上发亮。
lines.en: Originium grains glitter on my back.

lines.zh: 这里的水是咸的，我认得。
lines.en: This water is brackish. I know it.
I climb up through the rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 我的壳上长了一层青苔。
lines.en: A layer of moss has grown on my shell.
Something shifted under the surface.
The heat works into my shell seams.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，腹部一震。
lines.en: I landed on stone and my belly jolted.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝里，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Water pours into my shell and I kick hard.
I am on my back and cannot right myself.
An arrowhead is stuck in my pincer joint.
The originium on my shell pulses.

lines.zh: 这片水里没什么可吃的。
lines.en: There is little to eat in this water.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我全身一紧。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my whole body clenches.
I sink, and even the mud is gone.
